meta.era: Late Epoch 4 (Age of Machinery), before the Great Shattering

meta.note: Entries with confirmed:false are marked with '?' on the source chart and still need a canon decision.

layers.settlement: cities, towns, ruins and built sites
layers.people: tribes and civilizations; group is human or non-human

nations.name: Harappan-Lothal Industrial Union
nations.blurb: The guild nation. Foundries, clockwork factories and patent registries along the Saraswati estuaries, run from Kavik's retrofitted 22-story sandstone tower in Lothal.

nations.name: Narmada Academic Republic
nations.blurb: The enlightenment nation. A council of field historians and naturalists governs the central plateau and licenses fossil-energy extraction.

nations.name: Vanga Maritime Federation
nations.blurb: The oceanic nation. Former Tuli pearl-divers and delta merchants who control the eastern Tethys with ekranoplans and ironclad outriggers.

nations.name: Hyrkanian & Tushara Rail-Khanates
nations.blurb: Wind-hardened overland empire of the northern passes. Camelosuchus riders, armored trains, and a monopoly on coal and iron.

nations.name: Vayu & Dwarkadhish Coral Monarchies
nations.blurb: Two old coastal principalities under coral-stone arches: Vayu at North Dwarka and Dwarkadhish at Dwarka. They guard the Dwarka Gate and the sacred conch trade.

nations.name: Shwetavahana Riverine League
nations.blurb: The mercantile nation. Silvershore descendants who own the banks, locks and river tolls of the Saraswati and Godavari.

nations.name: Kingdom of Pragjyotisha
nations.blurb: A Harappan remnant kingdom on the eastern landmass, beyond the lava straits. How it relates to the Union is still open.

nations.name: Realm of Prince Vijaya
nations.blurb: Southern-tip kingdom around Tamraparni. Its politics and its ties to Kubera's Yakshas are still unwritten.

nations.name: Colonial holdings & outposts
nations.blurb: Overseas camps and trading piers: Mappa Mundi ironwood colonies, Tamralinga, and the Lemurian colony.

places.name: Mt Triglav
places.blurb: Northwest peak on the Panthalassa shore.

places.name: Hattusha
places.blurb: Anatolian town of the Mittani tribes.

places.name: Cimmerian tribes
places.blurb: Iron-willed highland clans who reject steam and guard the old mountain passes.

places.name: Anatolia
places.blurb: Green uplands at the western edge of the north.

places.name: Göbekli ruins
places.blurb: Ancient ruins in lands taken over by mythical beings.

places.name: Karahan ruins
places.blurb: Sister ruins east of Göbekli.

places.name: Uncharted lands
places.blurb: Ringed on your chart as a zone no survey has crossed.

places.name: Siberian grasslands
places.blurb: Steppe of various mammalian groups, stretching the width of the north.

places.name: Siberian gold deposits
places.blurb: Northern goldfields near Great Tartaria.

places.name: Tartari
places.blurb: Asura-hybrid people of Great Tartaria.

places.name: Kamchatka
places.blurb: Northeast cape on the Panthalassa.

places.name: Asura Planet Collision Zone
places.blurb: Impact crater of the Asura planet, ringed by a boiling ocean and irradiated wastelands.

places.name: Irradiated Wastelands
places.blurb: Scorched land around the collision zone.

places.name: Huna tribe
places.blurb: Tribe of the Tengri foothills.

places.name: Mt Tengri
places.blurb: Sky-peak above the Huna lands.

places.name: Magical beings
places.blurb: Beings who took the Vedda homeland; the Vedda themselves moved south and east.

places.name: Turanian Steppes
places.blurb: Isolated tribes, telegraph-riders, and the Silk-and-Coal overland corridors.

places.name: Dzungaria
places.blurb: Held by non-human entities.

places.name: Shaka-rauka
places.blurb: A new human tribe whose land is Shakastan, ruled from Sistan.

places.name: Sistan
places.blurb: Capital of the Shaka.

places.name: Gobi Desert
places.blurb: Held by non-human entities.

places.name: Tarim
places.blurb: Basin below the Gobi.

places.name: Kashmir
places.blurb: Highland valley town of the Bharata tribe.

places.name: Ladakh
places.blurb: High plateau near the Botai remnants.

places.name: Zagros
places.blurb: Western ranges toward Akkad.

places.name: Magical beings
places.blurb: Beings who took over the Jharwa homeland near Kohistan.

places.name: Kohistan
places.blurb: Frontier town of the Kalasha hills.

places.name: Kalasha frontier tribes
places.blurb: Frontier tribes below the passes.

places.name: Taklamakan Pass Fortress
places.blurb: Khanate fortress guarding the pass.

places.name: Mt Kai Lhasa
places.blurb: Great peak above the Hrycania outpost.

places.name: Tushara
places.blurb: Steppe telegraph-riders; half of the Rail-Khanates.

places.name: Bahlika
places.blurb: Khanate city where the Trans-Himalayan railway forks and the bridge line drops south to the island.

places.name: Hrycania outpost
places.blurb: Eastern terminus of the Trans-Himalayan railway. The 1884 Accord puts this corridor under joint Narmada-Hyrkanian administration.

places.name: Denisovans
places.blurb: A non-sapiens human lineage living beyond the Hrycania outpost.

places.name: Harappa
places.blurb: Ancestral city of the Mask Family, up the Saraswati on the mainland. By Epoch 4 it is a heritage city feeding stone-engineers to the Union.

places.name: Mohenjo-daro
places.blurb: West of the Saraswati. Old brick grid, now a river-lock town.

places.name: Sinauli
places.blurb: East bank. Home of the Sinauli-Vedda dialect of the old chariot traders.

places.name: Gedrosian Desert
places.blurb: Coal-scrapers mine fossil beds at its edge; Dune-Scavengers ride Camelosuchus through its ruins.

places.name: Makran coast
places.blurb: Dry coast west of the delta.

places.name: Great Junction Drydock
places.blurb: Where the Saraswati Canal meets the Tethys estuary. On D-Day the water drained into geothermal fissures here, and the Kelpfang-II set out from this pier.

places.name: Pragjyotisha
places.blurb: A Harappan remnant kingdom beyond the eastern strait, cut off from Lothal. Its ties to the Union are unwritten.

places.name: Ganga Lava Lake
places.blurb: Volcanic lake at the fringe of non-human lands. Ganges Ash-Nomads burn charcoal around it in obsidian goggles.

places.name: Vanga
places.blurb: Federation capital on stone piers and boardwalks above the tide. Tuli pearl-divers protest the steam dredgers tearing up black-oyster reefs.

places.name: Great Tethys Bridge
places.blurb: The rail bridge from Bahlika to the Aravalis, tying the island to the mainland corridor.

places.name: North Dwarka
places.blurb: Seat of the Vayu principality. Landing of the Delta Causeway, and closest port to the drowned Dwarka Gate.

places.name: Dwarka Gate (submerged)
places.blurb: Interdimensional basalt arches offshore. Drilling was halted after steam drills struck a geothermal Lingam bed and blue auroras rose from the arches.

places.name: Dwarka
places.blurb: Seat of the Dwarkadhish principality on the north shore. Freighters ran aground on the canal between here and Lothal when the water dropped.

places.name: Coastal villages
places.blurb: Fishing villages strung along the northern rail.

places.name: Aravali Ranges
places.blurb: Stony hills of the Glass-Herbalists. After D-Day, the wetlands below become the Aravali Yurt Sanctuary.

places.name: Hastinapura
places.blurb: Post-Harappan town on the northeastern plain.

places.name: Pataliputra
places.blurb: Post-Harappan town near the eastern rim.

places.name: Lothal
places.blurb: Capital of the Union. Red Tower Precinct, Tide-Lock Three, the Harappan Tidal Ironworks, and the Narmada Man's skull shrine under the Crystal Spire to the north.

places.name: Black Lotus
places.blurb: Town on the site of the old Black Lotus pirate camp that Varna drowned in flood and fire. Western rail junction.

places.name: Narmada University
places.blurb: University Ridge. Brass observatories on basalt cliffs, trams along the ridge avenue, Ananya's library.

places.name: Aranya rainforests
places.blurb: Dense rainforest east of University Ridge.

places.name: Deccan industrial zone
places.blurb: Copper-smelters harvesting sulfur and ore along the plateau cliffs.

places.name: City of Narmada
places.blurb: Republic capital and hub where the northern, western and eastern lines meet.

places.name: Deccan Plateau
places.blurb: Uplands east of Meru, between the Narmada and Godavari.

places.name: Primitive humans (west)
places.blurb: Unsettled lands along the western coast rail.

places.name: Primitive humans (east)
places.blurb: Unsettled lands inside the eastern rail loop.

places.name: Nilgiri (Nirigili) town
places.blurb: West-coast town of the Nilgiri Canopy-Keepers, where the coast rail meets the Meru spoke. Name still marked '?' on your chart.

places.name: Vengi
places.blurb: Marsh docks of the eastern coast. Devraj's red-fog morning happens at the Vengi Marsh Docks.

places.name: Simhapura
places.blurb: Southern end of the eastern line.

places.name: Utkala
places.blurb: Eastern spoke of the Meru rail star.

places.name: Chandraketugarh
places.blurb: Island city of the Vedda apothecary guilds, locked in a feud with Daedrasura's cultists over Garudasaur blood.

places.name: Geothermal stations
places.blurb: Offshore stations tapping the undersea lava lake and lava river.

places.name: Mount Meru
places.blurb: Sacred axis of the island, ringed by a circular railway with spokes to every mine. Excavation is underway on its northern slope.

places.name: Meru excavation
places.blurb: The Republic's dig into Meru itself.

places.name: Gold mine
places.blurb: Western foothills of Meru.

places.name: Diamond mine
places.blurb: Eastern foothills of Meru.

places.name: Ether mine
places.blurb: Extracts ether, a fuel with no mundane explanation yet.

places.name: Yakshas
places.blurb: Kubera's Yakshas hold the south of the island. The southern rail runs right through their land.

places.name: Prana extraction mine
places.blurb: Draws life-force (prana) out of the ground.

places.name: Onge tribes & Tuli remnants
places.blurb: Onge tribes and Tuli who never joined the Vanga Federation.

places.name: Tamraparni
places.blurb: Southern terminus of the Meru line. Marked '?' on your chart.

places.name: Prince Vijaya City
places.blurb: Seat of Prince Vijaya, who offers the Mask of Tethys to Khadi.

places.name: Tamralinga
places.blurb: Colony island shared with the Onge and Jarawa. Frost-skinned voyagers from the Southern Ice Wall trade ivory and blubber-resin at its outer pier.

places.name: Mappa Mundi Island
places.blurb: Ironwood jungle island in the far southwest, home of Sylvians and Vajraptors.

places.name: Lemuria
places.blurb: Southern landmass of the Nagaraptors and Vanaras. Deep-sea dredging in its trenches released the Moriah spore-blight.

places.name: Mittani tribes
places.blurb: The people of Hattusha.

places.name: Mythical beings
places.blurb: They took over the lands around the Göbekli ruins.

places.name: Isolated steppe tribes
places.blurb: Small tribes scattered across the Turanian steppes.

places.name: Non-human entities (Dzungaria)
places.blurb: Unnamed beings holding Dzungaria.

places.name: Non-human entities (Gobi)
places.blurb: Unnamed beings holding the Gobi.

places.name: Bharata tribe
places.blurb: Highland tribe of Kashmir.

places.name: Botai remnants
places.blurb: Last of the Botai, under the early Himalayas.

places.name: Saraswati Valley civilization
places.blurb: The old river civilization of Harappa, Mohenjo-daro and Sinauli, ancestors of the Mask Family and the Union.

places.name: Kia Clan
places.blurb: Fluid marsh-dwellers of the delta who ride bamboo rafts beside the river whales. Urbanised Kia artisans helped found the Union.

places.name: Elamite tribes
places.blurb: Western coastal tribes toward Akkad.

places.name: Gedrosian Dune-Scavengers
places.blurb: Desert nomads who ride Camelosuchus and zebu, sifting ruins for copper.

places.name: Early Maru tribes
places.blurb: Desert and steppe nomads along the northern rail; ancestors of the Epoch 5 Maru.

places.name: Soldier entities
places.blurb: Mostly soldier beings garrisoning the passes near Hrycania.

places.name: Non-human entities (Gangdese)
places.blurb: Unnamed beings of the Gangdese ranges.

places.name: Non-human entities (east)
places.blurb: Unnamed beings north of the Ganga Lava Lake.

places.name: Ganges Ash-Nomads
places.blurb: Miners and charcoal-burners of the lava fringes, in leather tunics and obsidian goggles.

places.name: Aravali Glass-Herbalists
places.blurb: Hill folk who harvest mineral plants and Garudasaur moss and blow heat-proof glass for apothecaries.

places.name: Tenduas
places.blurb: Articulate sphinx-cats of Permian descent. Narmada bestiaries wrongly file them as monstrous hybrids.

places.name: Post-Harappan townsfolk
places.blurb: The people of Hastinapura and Pataliputra.

places.name: Nilgiri Canopy-Keepers
places.blurb: Forest clans in timber villages high in the branches.

places.name: Vedda apothecaries
places.blurb: Urban Vedda of Chandraketugarh, feuding with Daedrasura's cultists over Garudasaur blood.

places.name: Onge & Jarawa
places.blurb: Indigenous peoples sharing Tamralinga with the colony.

places.name: Nagaraptors & Vanaras
places.blurb: Feathered raptor clans with a scale-based civilization, living alongside the Vanaras.

places.name: Mappa Mundi tribes
places.blurb: Indigenous humans who fight the colonial logging camps.

places.name: Vajraptor & Sylvian flocks
places.blurb: Feathered theropods allied with the tribes; they help cut the telegraph wire.

places.name: New Borneo colony
places.blurb: Colonial ironwood camp on Mappa Mundi.

places.name: Samgam City
places.blurb: Colony city on Lemuria.

faults.name: Saraswati canal drain
faults.blurb: Canal levels drop three feet overnight; forty freighters aground between Dwarka and Lothal. Engineers blame the central basalt fault.

faults.name: Dwarka Gate drilling
faults.blurb: Spatial tremors and blue auroras after drills hit a geothermal Lingam bed.

faults.name: Lemurian trench dredging
faults.blurb: Source of the Moriah spore-blight, 'Fossil-Lung'. Lothal factory wards under 21-day quarantine.

faults.name: Undersea lava river
faults.blurb: Deep-earth magnetic anomalies; red fog and ozone over the Vengi marshes.

faults.name: Meru excavation (suspected)
faults.blurb: Not named in the chronicles as a cause. A hook if you want the Shattering to start at the world's axis.
